data.name: Save_ExcelWheelMessage
data.value: You scrolled {0} time(s) with the mouse wheel in Excel. One notch does not always scroll the same number of rows, so in a loop the macro can drift to the wrong row and copy wrong data without any error. The arrow keys move exactly one cell. Select cells with the keyboard too: a click hits the same spot on the screen in every loop.
